name: Punishing Altar

stealth.details: (trained) to notice the bowl is the center point for a magical trap

disable: DC 22 Thievery check (expert) to remove the bowl without triggering the magic, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank, counteract DC 20) to counteract the runes

items.name: Necromantic Wave
items.text:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the bowl without displaying a religious symbol of Venexus

---

Effect The bowl releases a wave of necromantic energy, dealing 4d8+10 void damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save) to the triggering creature and all creatures in the area not displaying a religious symbol of Venexus. On a critical failure, a creature becomes Drained 1.

text: The bowl releases a wave of negative energy when a living creature approaches without displaying a religious symbol of Venexus.
